segments.text: So, he says, Bija with Anam, Karthavya with Sisha, so supreme energy of Lord, which is
the main cause of this universe, that is Bija.
You have to meditate and contemplate on it every now and then, in continuity.
After you realize it, not till you realize it, till you have realized it, you want to
do it in continuity.
At the time when you realize it, that strength comes by itself, that strength of meditating
on it in continuity, that strength comes by itself whenever you, so suppose you are given
to Samadhi, and you have not realized the real nature of yourself, till then you want
to relax and relax, relax and relax.
Go to bed, sleep, just take rest, lean, you do all these nonsense things.
But whenever you feel and realize the reality of self, you become active.
Afterwards you become active for your whole life, you will never remain inactive.
But, activities comes from above after realization.
So once you have realized it, you have to remain absolutely active in your remaining part
of life.
So, Bija, that germ, which is understood and realized in Samadhi, that is the cause of whole
universe, Vishakaranam.
And that is Svratatma, Parashakti, that is the supreme energy of Shiva, Sathandarshaakti.
Saiyuni, Sarvadeva Nam, Shakti Nam, Chaapini, Kada, Agni, Shomath, Mika, Yoni, Stata, Sarvam,
Pravati.
That germ, or that supreme energy of Lord Shiva, is the cause of all organic world, is the
cause of all energies, is the cause of breathing, breath, inhale and exhale.
And in other words, this is the universal cause, Tatra, Parashakti, Arthmani, Bija, Avadhanam.
What is Avadhanam?
Avadhanam means you have to put, again and again, you have to put your mind and intellect on
that point, again and again, without any powers, in continuity.
